name: phoenix-axp
description: Phoenix AXP (Agentic Experience Platform): multi-tenant DXP, modular monolith.

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r build && node scripts/check-built-kernel.mjs
scripts.db:bootstrap: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d phoenix -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/10-bootstrap-dev.sql
scripts.verify: pnpm db:generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm licences && pnpm test && pnpm test:db && pnpm db:check-reversible
scripts.boundaries: pnpm --filter @phoenix/api boundaries && node scripts/check-prisma-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-module-bindings.mjs
